construction_principle: Each pair keeps the same approximate proposition while changing the source of epistemic authority. The positive pole anchors the claim in scripture, doctrine, liturgy, law, ritual teaching, sacred narrative, or another recognized internal source. The negative pole attributes the same claim to believers, practitioners, followers, readers, families, or communities without naming that internal source.
